{{Citation}}
{{Quote|Information is like plasma; it can bind, or it can burn.|Yuuzhan Vong priest|<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Dark Journey">''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Journey]]''</ref>}}
[[File:NightsisterEnergyBowFired-TCWs4BR3.png|thumb|right|300px|Nightsister energy bows fired bolts of plasma.]]
'''Plasma''' was one of the five fundamental states of matter, the other four being solid, liquid, gas and supercritical fluid. Made of a loose mixture of positive and negative charged particles, plasma was the most abundant form of matter in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It was naturally produced in [[Star/Legends|stars]], and a rarefied form of it filled the intergalactic regions. It was created when a gas got ionized at high temperature, energized or subjected to a strong electromagnetic field.<ref name="BMF14">{{BuildFalconCite|14|Guide to the Galaxy}}</ref>

==Weaponry==

During the Old Republic, weaponry dealing with plasma was known as plasmatech or pyrotech and was considered a discipline.<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]''</ref>

[[Blaster/Legends|Blasters]] shot magnetically contained plasma, created by ionization of high-energy gas.<ref>''[[Star Wars: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech]] DC-model blasters from the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] fired blue, plasma bolts using a hyper-ionizer,<ref>''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> specially designed for fighting infantry and vehicles alike.<ref name="Battlefront Game Guide">[[Star Wars Battlefront: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars Battlefront'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref> [[Plasma disruptor/Legends|Plasma disruptors]] shot bolts that would arc to multiple targets, if clustered together, being an expensive, yet effective tool against droid armies.<ref name="Battlefront Game Guide" />

The [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] used [[Nightsister energy bow/Legends|energy bows]] that shot bolts of plasma.

The [[Zann Consortium/Legends|Zann Consortium]] used several ships and vehicles equipped with [[Plasma cannon/Legends|plasma cannons]] designed to shoot two shots spiraling around each other and inflict massive damage.

[[Yuuzhan Vong]] ships shot balls of plasma.

==Mining==
The planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] was known to export plasma as early as the reign of King [[Ars Veruna/Legends|Ars Veruna]].<ref name="Plagueis">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref> When used in [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]], it was more effective against [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and shields, while the more common concentrated particle beams were more effective against living beings.

In the [[Mining/Legends|mines]] on [[Oovo IV/Legends|Oovo IV]] a tool called the [[Gasifier]] turned rock into plasma.

Plasma fires could burn for [[Standard year/Legends|years]]. After a [[Mining/Legends|mining]] accident at the [[Mesa 291]] [[lidium]] [[Mine/Legends|mine]] on [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]], plasma fires raged for at least two generations below the surface.<ref name="Breakout">{{WEGCite|story=Rebel Breakout|book=Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Although previous sources had established the [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber's]] blade as being made of pure energy,<ref name="Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref><ref name="Duel With a Dark Lady">[[Star Wars (1977) (10[0-8]|7[6-9]|[8-9][0-9])|''Star Wars'' (1977) 96]]</ref><ref name="Knights of the Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref> it was on one occasion described as being made from plasma.<ref name="ShadowsOfMindor">''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]''</ref>
